versions.changelog:
Initial release of archunit-architecture-guard.

- Scans Java/Kotlin projects to detect architecture patterns (layered/MVC, DDD, hexagonal, clean, modular monolith, Android MVVM).
- Reports architecture smells and provides concrete refactoring guidance.
- Generates ArchUnit guard tests to enforce detected architecture and prevent future erosion.
- Freezes existing violations as baseline — only new violations will fail the build by default.
- Full workflow and recommendations documented for maintainers and users in both Chinese and English.
